description: facebook: Profile. GET /v1/facebook/profile. Get a public Facebook page's profile, as a signed-out visitor sees it: id, name, adLibrary.pageId (the id the Ad Library uses), exact followerCount and talkingAboutCount, category, intro, address, phone, email, website, services, price range, rating, and the cover and profile photos. adLibrary.adStatus, creationDate and businessHours are not on the signed-out page and are omitted; likeCount appears only when the page Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Use a cached response this old or newer for 0 credits. If none is available, fetch live at the endpoint’s normal price.

get_business_hours.description: Accepted for compatibility and ignored: opening hours are not on the signed-out page.

include_gated_profile.description: Accepted for compatibility and ignored: gated and age-restricted pages need a login and fail at 0 credits.

url.description: The URL of the public Facebook page (facebook.com/<name>, profile.php?id= or /people/<name>/<id>)

name: facebook_profile
